head: codex/5913-repair-adl-review-compatibility-routing
title: [v0.92][Sprint 6][tools] Repair adl-review compatibility routing
body:
## Summary

- Repairs `adl-review verify-repo-contract` so it validates repository-review packets through the supported read-only compatibility path.
- Repairs deterministic fixture-mode `adl-review code-review` routing for the CodeFriend/CodeBuddy smoke surface without provider credentials.
- Narrows stale/hidden `adl-review` help and diagnostics so removed v1 lifecycle/provider surfaces fail closed without advertising unsupported routing.
- Keeps PR-fast CLI selector routing current by removing the removed `adl-session` binary id and preserving `adl-process` coverage.
- Hardens `verify-repo-contract` against review markers hidden inside fenced code blocks, including longer fences containing shorter fence marker lines.

## Validation

- `cargo fmt --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml -- --check`
- `bash adl/tools/test_adl_review_compatibility.sh`
- `bash adl/tools/test_run_pr_fast_test_lane.sh`
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --bin adl-review -- -D warnings`
- Fresh exact-head C-SDLC review: `fresh-session:aef4db36-d5be-4dc2-80df-00067c3cac7d` PASS at assigned revision `git-blake3:88aea76500cacf1cbdec935c477b438331397bc3:576a799a9129870d5b9af64b7545f39ecf05ffebed9933c7e5ec55e4f7089fe0`.

Closes #5913
